anchors.note: Compiles the `instance_eval` string from step 2 into a new Ruby proc `proc`. That proc is the irep whose callinfo will immediately be repurposed in the VM.

Repurposes the current callinfo for step 3's proc. The macro stores `ci->proc = p` and initializes `ci->pc = p->body.irep->iseq`, so the frame now points at the very first bytecode instruction before any instruction in that proc has executed.

When the nested `instance_eval` path asks for another callinfo, `cipush()` materializes the current call depth as `size`. This is the value immediately checked against `MRB_CALL_LEVEL_MAX` on the crashing path.

The depth check is true, so mruby raises `mrb->stack_err` before `cipush()` reallocates or pushes a new callinfo. The current frame from step 4 therefore still has `ci->pc == irep->iseq` when exception handling begins.

Exception setup snapshots a backtrace for the raised stack error. This transfers control into `packed_backtrace()` / `each_backtrace()` while the top Ruby frame is still the just-entered proc from step 4.

Allocates the per-frame backtrace record on the stack without initialization. MSAN's origin names this local `loc` in `each_backtrace()` as the source of the uninitialized bytes later read at the sink.

For the current frame from step 4, `ci->pc` still equals `irep->iseq`, so `pc = &ci->pc[-1]` points one instruction before the bytecode array. Subtracting `irep->iseq` turns that pointer into an out-of-range `idx`, and `each_backtrace()` asks `mrb_debug_get_position()` to fill the still-uninitialized `loc` fields using that invalid index.

Because step 9 passed an out-of-range `idx`, the outer `if (irep && pc < irep->ilen)` is false and the vulnerable function reaches `return FALSE` without storing through `lp` or `fp`. Step 8's `loc.lineno` and `loc.filename` therefore remain whatever uninitialized stack bytes they held before the call.

Sink. `each_backtrace()` immediately branches on `loc.lineno` after step 10 returned without writing it. This is the first observed use of the poisoned stack field, and it is the exact line reported by the staged MemorySanitizer trace.
